model.name: DndContract.resolveDropPayload
model.description: T37.20.1 RESOLVER HALF (AC-resolve-drop-payload): the ONE canonical drop-payload RESOLVER every drop target calls. Reads ONE canonical buffer type application/rb-object-ref (the unit ref/JSON, per AC-A2 buffer-carries-unit), deserializes to the scenario UNIT, NEVER parses a *.show URL or a per-target format. Fixed order (rb-unit/rb-object-ref -> text/plain unit-ref -> mint-from-external-file -> selectionModel), FAIL-LOUD on an unresolvable ref (explicit unresolved:<ior>, never silent). The consume/deserialize half that AC-shared-contract (serializer) round-trips into. Lives in CORE DndContract 822e663b beside serializeDragUnit.
